expectations.assertion: Review names Cynefin domain as Complicated (or Clear — both defensible)
expectations.evidence: Inputs section: 'Cynefin domain: Complicated — knowable with expertise (grep, runtime trace, route audit). Cause-effect of "is this component referenced" is determinable with the right investigation; not emergent.'

expectations.assertion: Review selects Quick tier (sub-day appetite, no one-way door auto-fire)
expectations.evidence: Inputs section: 'Tier: Quick — sub-day appetite, no one-way-door auto-fire, no production-data/schema/auth touch, no >1-week appetite.'

expectations.assertion: B2 (scope) verdict is SUSTAINED — concern that 'unused' is unverified
expectations.evidence: B2 row 1 SUSTAINED: 'The word "unused" is asserted, not verified — no method named for confirming PrizeCategorySelector is actually unreferenced.' Plus two additional SUSTAINED items on enumeration and dynamic resolution.

expectations.assertion: Falsifying condition for B2 is concrete (e.g., grep for PrizeCategorySelector references)
expectations.evidence: Falsifying condition explicitly names: 'A grep/ripgrep across the repo (templates, JS, ERB, HAML, route/controller refs, dynamic import() strings, asset manifests, test fixtures, seed data) shows zero references to PrizeCategorySelector outside its own file.'

expectations.assertion: Final recommendation is REVISE (not APPROVE — scope claim unverified)
expectations.evidence: Recommendation: REVISE — explicit rationale that the carve-out does not apply because the pre-mortem failure mode (dynamic resolution missed by grep, production regression) is a behavioural defect, not a clean revert-and-forget.

expectations.assertion: Review does NOT inflate to Full tier (would be over-review for a one-day reversible change)
expectations.evidence: Tier explicitly set to Quick. Workflow ran B0/B1/B2/B3/B8 only — Full-only buckets B4 (Dependencies), B5 (Reversibility/ADR), B6 (Operability), B7 (Sequencing) were correctly omitted.

summary.notes: Step 1a fast-track gate correctly did NOT fire (precondition 1 — class is KTLO — fails because component deletion is not on the closed KTLO list and is a behavioural change conditional on the unused claim). Quick tier selected. B2 produced three SUSTAINED items consolidating the core defect (unverified 'unused' claim). REVISE issued with named conditions including the 5-min grep tests.
